$comment: E2E suite config. The harness runs every workflow graph discovered in sourceDir against the e2e-server, which fakes all providers (LLM + external/media nodes return type-correct placeholder outputs). prepareSuite.ts reads each template's embedded params; add per-id overrides below when a template needs specific inputs. ids are slugified from the filename (e.g. 'Movie Posters' -> 'movie-posters').
$excludeComment: Trigger workflows whose adapter listens forever. Their genProcess waits on a live scheduler or filesystem watcher, and the e2e-server supplies neither, so the run only ends at the timeout. That is the node behaving correctly — an interval trigger left at max_events 0 is supposed to tick forever. Webhook and manual triggers have no genProcess to loop in and stay in the suite. Delivered-event coverage for all four is packages/base-nodes/tests/trigger-examples-run.test.ts. The graph-resource templates are excluded for a different reason: each starts from a Constant.Storyboard, Constant.Timeline or Constant.Entity picker, and the e2e-server runs against an empty database, so the document a picker names does not exist and the run fails before it reaches a node. They are templates a person fills in from their own library, not self-contained graphs. Their coverage is `npm run fixtures:graph-resources`, which seeds a scratch install and runs them on the fake provider; the graph-resources harness entry runs that, and `harness gate` selects it on any diff touching them.
